Theme

Money, work & business · Town, shops & places

pay by card phrase

also contactless, pay contactless, tap your card, card payment

* our formation

* (our own formation) tabellā solvere

phrase: the ablative of tabella with solvere

pay with a card

Our description, with the lexicon’s solvere (pay) and tabella (credit card, debit card; Traupman’s word). No reference work has a term for card or contactless payment.

Other words

  • * (our own formation) tabellam māchinae appōnere — tap the card: pay contactless

    also used · * our formation

    The card is only held to the reader, as a ticket is (tap the ticket: tesseram māchinae appōnere).

Examples

  • Nummōs nōn habeō; tabellā solvam.

    I’ve no cash on me; I’ll pay by card.composed

See also pay, credit card, debit card, tap the ticket, cash.

SourcesLewis & Short: chartula · Lewis & Short: solvo · Lewis & Short: appono

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
